title: Perfume Making Workshop in Atlanta
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Crafting your own perfume offers a unique opportunity to create a fragrance that reflects your individuality. This interactive experience allows you to select from an array of base, middle, and top notes, guiding you through the art of perfumery. Experiment with various scent combinations to discover your perfect blend, turning the process into a creative journey. This personalized fragrance not only serves as an expression of yourself but also makes for a memorable gift, evoking cherished memories and special occasions.
